name: Our name dialog's keys next to Jellyfin Enhanced's shortcuts, in the je sandbox, next to Jellyfin Enhanced with its fixture keys (B bookmark, S subtitles, R random item and speed reset, O skip intro, 0-9 jump to a percentage): as viewer on Chaptered Movie with 'Always ask for a name' and 'Pause while naming' on, Shift+B opens our name dialog with 'Bank job' suggested and selected; 'Bank job 2' typed key by key (Shift+B, a, n, k, Space, j, o, b, Space, 2) lands in the field and nothing of JE fires (no JE action or toast, no button JE clicks, no seek, no route change) and no second bookmark is made; Tab moves to Save, where S, R, O and 2 still do nothing; Enter saves the name. Then, as a positive control, 2 on the video page with no dialog open is JE's jump to 20 %. JE's actions are watched by probes/je-spy-probe.js. The bookmark is deleted at the end; bookmarks-je-web-probe.mjs puts viewer's naming preferences back.

steps.name: install JE's action spies before any page script
sign in as viewer
the Bookmarks script ran
find Chaptered Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Chaptered Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: viewer's 'Bank job 2' bookmarks of an earlier run deleted
steps.script: let n = 0; for (const b of await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))) { if (b.Name === 'Bank job 2') { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + b.Id) }); n++; } } return n;

steps.name: bookmarks on the movie before
'Always ask for a name' and 'Pause while naming' on (POST /Bookmarks/Preferences)
steps.script: await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Preferences'), data: JSON.stringify({ AskForName: true, PauseWhileNaming: true }), contentType: 'application/json' }); return await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Preferences'));

steps.name: a fresh read of the capabilities: reload
the Bookmarks script ran again, with the preferences
JE's keys as its config has them
steps.eval: (async () => { const c = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('JellyfinEnhanced/public-config')); const k = (n) => ((c.Shortcuts || []).find(s => s.Name === n) || {}).Key; return { bookmarks: c.BookmarksEnabled, all: c.DisableAllShortcuts, B: k('BookmarkCurrentTime'), S: k('SubtitleMenu'), R: [k('PlayRandomItem'), k('ResetPlaybackSpeed')], O: k('SkipIntroOutro'), digits: k('JumpToPercentage') }; })()

steps.name: the fixture's keys: JE's bookmarks on with B, S, R, O and 0-9
open the details page
details page with a Play button
start playback
video page, video playing
JE's key listener is there and its actions are spied on
our OSD buttons are there
inside 'Bank job' (12-24 s)
Shift, then Shift+B
the name dialog at once with 'Bank job' selected, the video paused
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); const v = document.querySelector('.videoPlayerContainer video'); if (!p || p.querySelector('h3').textContent !== 'Name this bookmark' || !v.paused) return false; const input = p.querySelector('input[type=text]'); return { value: input.value, focused: document.activeElement === input, selection: [input.selectionStart, input.selectionEnd], currentTime: v.currentTime, hash: location.hash }; })()

steps.name: the suggestion selected in the focused field
reset the spies and the bookmark count
type 'Bank job 2' key by key: Shift+B
what the typing did
steps.eval: (async () => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); const v = document.querySelector('.videoPlayerContainer video'); return { value: p ? p.querySelector('input[type=text]').value : null, dialogs: document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-backdrop').length, currentTime: v.currentTime, paused: v.paused, hash: location.hash, jeModal: !!document.querySelector('.je-bm-player-modal-overlay'), actionSheets: document.querySelectorAll('.actionSheet').length, spy: window.__jeSpy.summary(), bookmarks: (await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))).length }; })()

steps.name: every key reached the field ('Bank job 2'), none of JE's actions fired (no action, toast or button JE clicks, no seek, no route change, no JE modal, no sheet), and Shift+B in the field made no bookmark
Tab
where the focus is
steps.eval: (() => { const a = document.activeElement; return { text: a && a.textContent, inDialog: !!(a && a.closest('.jfbm-backdrop')) }; })()

steps.name: four Tabs from the field reach Save (the checkbox, More…, Skip, Save), inside the dialog
reset the spies
S, R, O and 2 on Save
what they did
steps.eval: (async () => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); const v = document.querySelector('.videoPlayerContainer video'); return { value: p ? p.querySelector('input[type=text]').value : null, dialogs: document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-backdrop').length, focus: document.activeElement && document.activeElement.textContent, currentTime: v.currentTime, paused: v.paused, rate: v.playbackRate, hash: location.hash, jeModal: !!document.querySelector('.je-bm-player-modal-overlay'), actionSheets: document.querySelectorAll('.actionSheet').length, spy: window.__jeSpy.summary(), bookmarks: (await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))).length }; })()

steps.name: still nothing from JE: no subtitle sheet, random item, speed reset, skip or seek; the dialog open with the focus on Save and the name kept
Enter saves
named: the dialog gone, our toast, the server's name
steps.waitFor: (async () => { if (document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop')) return false; const toast = [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-toast')].find(t => t.textContent === 'Named "Bank job 2".'); if (!toast) return false; const list = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId })); const b = list.find(x => x.Name === 'Bank job 2'); return b ? { id: b.Id, startSeconds: b.StartTicks / 10000000, count: list.length } : false; })()

steps.name: one bookmark, in 'Bank job', named 'Bank job 2'
playback resumed (the pause while naming ends with the dialog)
positive control: reset the spies, the video's time
2 on the video page, no dialog open
JE's jump to 20 % fired (so the spies see JE's actions)
steps.waitFor: (() => { const s = window.__jeSpy.summary(); const call = s.calls.find(c => c.fn === 'jumpToPercentage'); return call ? { args: call.args, currentTime: document.querySelector('.videoPlayerContainer video').currentTime } : false; })()

steps.name: it asked for 20 %
delete the bookmark this check made
steps.script: let n = 0; for (const b of await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))) { if (b.Name === 'Bank job 2') { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + b.Id) }); n++; } } return n;
